text:
Type: coffee table with magazine sling
Use: holding drinks, storing magazines and books; living room
Style: modern, industrial, mid-century modern
Materials: walnut finish wood top and lower shelf, black metal frame, tan leather sling
Colors: warm dark walnut brown, black, cognac tan
Shape: open rectangular black frame, top covering part of the length, lower shelf, hanging leather magazine sling at one end, light and open
Feel: warm, crafted, airy
Goes with: leather sofas, walnut wood, black accents, cream walls; modern or mid-century living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Heather Modern Coffee Table, 47.2 Inch Width, Walnut
product.description: Add a sense of modern simplicity to your home décor while improving your room’s organization with this beautiful coffee table. The walnut-hued top and base are supported by an elegant but sturdy metal frame, and the extra leather bag allows for easy storage of books and magazines. 47.2"W x 23.6"D x 15.7"H Walnut-colored MDF on a metal frame, with a leather bag Mid-century design updated to complement a modern simple style This table's 2 layers of shelves and extra leather bag offer convenient organization options. No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
